description: This file contains unit tests for the IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, which detects duplicate [Id] attributes in classes, structs, records, and records structs marked with [GenerateSerializer] attribute in Orleans serialization. The tests verify correct detection of duplicate IDs and ensure that non-serialized types are ignored.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, verifying detection of duplicate [Id] attributes in serialized types in Orleans.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method to verify that a given code snippet produces the expected number of diagnostics (errors) related to duplicate [Id] attributes.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method to verify that a given code snippet does not produce any diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test method to validate that the analyzer detects duplicate [Id] attributes in types marked with [GenerateSerializer], including classes, structs, records, and record structs.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndNoDuplicatedIds_ShouldNoTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test method to confirm that the analyzer does not report diagnostics when all [Id] attributes are unique in serialized types.

methods.name: TypesWithoutGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test method to verify that the analyzer ignores types not marked with [GenerateSerializer], even if they contain duplicate [Id] attributes.
